A pure-white fawn picks its way across a mossy ledge, eyes soft and unafraid.
Seven white swans glide the green stream in silence, trailing silver ripples behind them.
A white unicorn lowers its horn gently to touch the water's still surface.
Cherry-blossom petals tumble in a slow pink cascade down the moss-furred gorge walls.
A procession of warm fae-lights drifts single-file along the woven root-bridge at dusk.
Glowing pixies spiral upward beside the waterfall like a swirl of living embers.
The great low moon rests above the canyon rim, tender and impossibly close.
A russet fox pauses on a wet rock, watching the stream with quiet curiosity.
A giant friendly snail crosses the petal-strewn path, shell gleaming like polished jade.
Glow-moths lift from the meadow grasses in one soft, trembling luminous cloud together.
A rainbow hangs inside the waterfall mist, faint and perfect as a whispered secret.
A white owl glides the length of the gorge without a single wingbeat.
A great jewel-winged butterfly drifts between two blossoming flower-houses, unhurried and enormous.
A river otter spins lazily on its back among the cool amber-lit shallows.
Three white swans circle a moonlit pool, their reflections doubling the soft silver light.
A fae-lantern bobs loose from the bridge and floats gently down the dark stream.
The unicorn steps back into the flowering trees and disappears like a quiet thought.
Pink petals settle on the white fawn's back as it stands perfectly still.
Two glowing pixies chase each other through the open window of a mushroom-cap cottage.
A glow-moth lands on a sleeping child's windowsill, pulsing once, warm as a candle.
The low moon casts long honey shadows across every mossy rooftop in the village.
A cloud of cherry blossoms swirls upward suddenly, carried by one warm unseen breath.
The white owl lands on the root-bridge railing and blinks at the fae-lights calmly.
A small fox kit curls asleep on a warm stepping-stone beside the glowing stream.
The giant butterfly folds its wings once over the village square, and dusk begins.
